metadata.subject: English
integrityRules: Only explicit Grade 1–12 records are included in the graded public curriculum.
Age-only, adult, and grade-not-stated records are never assigned to a grade by inference.
A Main Topic or Subtopic may appear in multiple grades as curriculum complexity increases.
Only an exact duplicate inside the same Grade, Main Topic, and Subtopic is removed.
Similar umbrella and detailed topics inside the same grade remain separate unless the source is explicitly revised.
metadata.countingRule: Main Topics and Subtopics are counted by grade placement; repetition across different grades is intentional progression.

description.en: Build decoding, phonics, phonological awareness, spelling, syllabication, and automatic word recognition.
description.ar: بناء مهارات فك الرموز والصوتيات والوعي الصوتي والتهجئة وتقسيم المقاطع والتعرف التلقائي على الكلمات.
